variant: XC600.2 (2.5 m horizontal, 4.8 m vertical reach)
name: Befard XC600.2 glazing robot
summary: Battery electro-hydraulic wheeled glazing robot with six vacuum cups that lifts glass, windows and panels of up to 600 kg to about 4.8 m and sets them into openings by radio remote control. Made by Befard in Poland as the mid-size model between the XC400 and XC820.

germany.statusNote: Befard sells the XC600.2 on request; its Maschinensucher.de listing for the XC600.1 (€20,900 plus VAT) says the 4.8 m model XC600.2 is also available, without a price. Befard names GreenLifter in Fürth as its German sales partner.

sellers.name: Befard
sellers.note: Ul. Pod Grapą 4, 43-340 Kozy, Poland. Contact form, phone and WhatsApp on the product page; the Maschinensucher.de listing says "AUCH VERFÜGBAR: MODELL XC600.2 – REICHWEITE 4,8 M".

sellers.name: GreenLifter
sellers.note: Boxdorfer Str. 35, 90765 Fürth. Named by Befard as its German sales partner ("Niemcy - GreenLifter"); this model is not shown on a GreenLifter page.

specs.label: Vacuum cups
specs.conditions: 100 mm side shift of the cup beam, variable cup spacing
specs.quote: 100 mm Seitenverschub der Saugtraverse, variabler Sauger Abstand für mehr Flexibilität.

specs.label: Power
specs.quote: Akku-/elektrohydraulischer Montageroboter für Glas, Fenster und Flächen (Innen/Außen).

notes: Arm = hydraulic telescopic boom with a vacuum cup beam; options include hydraulic side shift and beam rotation (each reduces the load by 100 kg), hook and forks.
Battery electro-hydraulic machine, steered by an operator with the Befard radio remote control; not autonomous.
Indoor and outdoor use per maker ("Innen/Außen"); two side outriggers ("Zwei Stützen").
Drive type, speed and runtime are not stated on the pages read.
